items.title: Publish the audited benchmark architecture and M0 acceptance contract
items.context: Import exact reviewed plan and follow-up conditions; preserve audit scope and future M1-M3 boundaries.
items.userSees: A repository-owned implementation plan with explicit M0 pass conditions.

items.title: Provide executable probes for current-host benchmark feasibility
items.context: Observe actual sandbox, CLI/build binding, launch profile, usage raw retention, reviewer import and machine admission boundaries. Probes must distinguish real receipt-backed observations from static support or unknowns.
items.userSees: A reproducible readiness report that cannot report unsupported capability as ready.

items.title: Record bounded feasibility results and the next milestone decision
items.context: Execute supported probes, retain failed or blocked outcomes and phase/resource measurement limits, and bind the go/no-go report to source/build/environment. A full-lifecycle unsupported result is a disclosed no-go, never fabricated success.
items.userSees: Concrete current-host evidence and actionable M1 prerequisites.
